slice: Natural conversation round 10: empathetic handling of emotional statements

replies.i've been feeling really down lately: I hear you — that's a lot to carry. I'm here if you want to talk it out, or we can just sit with it.
replies.i had a rough day: I hear you — that's a lot to carry. I'm here if you want to talk it out, or we can just sit with it.

before.i've been feeling really down lately: I don't have a good answer on feeling yet — what's it like from your side?
before.i'm so stressed: So Stressed — nice to put a name to you. I'll remember that.

mechanism: detect emotional/situational statements and reply with warmth (opening a door to talk) instead of a dry topic follow-up; also fixes 'i'm so <state>' being misread as an introduction
